title: DevOps Engineer
description: About Ginesys Ginesys is India's leading retail technology platform, powering 1,200+ customers and 50,000+ users through the unified GinesysOne suite — ERP, Cloud POS (Zwing), Order Management (Browntape), GST Compliance (EaseMyGST), and BI (InsightX). We are evolving from a System of Records to a System of Intelligence through Ginesys.AI. http://About the role Ginesys Insights runs on Google Cloud , connected to our ERP estate on Azure . ERP data flows from the primary PostgreSQL databases through Debezium change-data-capture into Kafka . From there, Kafka Connect loads it into the BigQuery raw layer, and Dataform transforms it into the silver and gold layers. The application (Java backend, Next.js frontend, Cube semantic layer) runs on Cloud Run with Cloud SQL PostgreSQL. We need a hands-on DevOps Engineer to own this infrastructure end to end: keep the data pipeline healthy, take everything to infrastructure-as-code, and build production-grade UAT and Production environments. What you'll do Infrastructure as code Own the Terraform code base for GCP: organisation, folders and projects; Shared VPC; HA VPN to Azure; Cloud NAT; GKE; Cloud Run; Cloud SQL; Secret Manager; Artifact Registry; IAM and Workload Identity Federation; BigQuery datasets and access. Bring manually created resources under code (import), manage remote state safely, and detect and fix drift between code and live. Build UAT and Production environments from reusable modules, with high availability (regional GKE and Cloud SQL, redundant VPN tunnels) and private networking (private GKE endpoint, private Cloud SQL, serverless VPC access). Data ingestion pipeline (CDC) Operate and tune the CDC pipeline from PostgreSQL to the BigQuery raw layer. Debezium PostgreSQL source connectors: logical replication slots, publications, WAL retention, heartbeats and snapshot strategy. Kafka clusters (KRaft) and Kafka Connect on Kubernetes using the Strimzi operator. The BigQuery sink connector: topic routing, transforms (SMTs), schema evolution, partitioning and clustering. Monitor consumer lag, replication-slot lag and connector task health. Configure dead-letter queues and error handling. Manage offsets, resets and re-snapshots safely. Write and maintain the runbook for onboarding a new customer (tenant) onto the pipeline, and for recovering from connector, slot or offset failures. Support the data team with Dataform release and workflow configurations, scheduling and BigQuery cost control. Kubernetes and application platform Run GKE in production: node pools and autoscaling, Workload Identity, upgrades, PodDisruptionBudgets, resource and JVM tuning for Kafka Connect. Introduce GitOps (Argo CD or Flux) and Helm/Kustomize so cluster state lives in Git. Operate Cloud Run services (backend, frontend, Cube): revisions, traffic splitting, canary releases and rollback. CI/CD Build GitHub Actions pipelines for infrastructure: terraform fmt/validate/plan on every pull request, approved apply through Workload Identity Federation (no keys), and scheduled drift detection. Maintain container build and release pipelines for the application, Kafka Connect images and Cube, including image scanning and Artifact Registry clean-up policies. Observability, security, cost and reliability Set up monitoring and alerting with Cloud Monitoring, Prometheus or Grafana: pipeline freshness, Kafka lag, connector state, Cloud Run errors and latency, Cloud SQL health. Define SLOs, run on-call and write blameless post-incident reviews. Harden security: group-based least-privilege IAM, Secret Manager with rotation, no secrets or state files in Git, closed firewall rules, private endpoints and audit logging. Own FinOps : budgets and alerts, BigQuery bytes and slots, GKE right-sizing, and scaling non-production environments down outside working hours. Own backup and disaster recovery : Cloud SQL point-in-time recovery, BigQuery table recovery, multi-zone design, and tested DR runbooks. Work closely with the ERP infrastructure team (Azure AKS, VPN, source PostgreSQL), the data team and the application team. Must have Around 5 years in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering, including 2+ years running production workloads on Google Cloud . Strong Terraform : module design, remote state, import blocks, environment layout, and safe plan/apply practice. Solid GCP : VPC and Shared VPC, Cloud VPN, Cloud NAT, IAM and service accounts, Workload Identity Federation, GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Secret Manager, Artifact Registry, Cloud Logging and Monitoring. Production Kubernetes experience: kubectl, Helm, operators and custom resources, Workload Identity, troubleshooting pods and networking. Hands-on Apache Kafka and Kafka Connect operations: topics, partitions, consumer groups and lag, offsets, SASL/SCRAM and TLS. Debezium change-data-capture from PostgreSQL : logical replication, replication slots, publications, WAL retention and snapshot modes. PostgreSQL administration basics: backups and PITR, connections and pooling, replication. CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Docker. Monitoring and alerting design, and incident handling. Linux and scripting in Bash and/or Python. Security-first habits: least privilege, secret management, network hardening. Good to have Strimzi operator and the Confluent/WePay BigQuery sink connector; Schema Registry with Avro. BigQuery administration (datasets, IAM, slots, cost controls) and Dataform or dbt. Cube.js deployment and operations. Azure basics: VPN gateways, AKS, Entra ID and workload identity federation. GitOps with Argo CD or Flux; Kustomize. JVM tuning for Kafka Connect; PowerShell. Certifications: Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer or Cloud Architect, CKA/CKAD, Confluent Kafka. Using AI coding assistants for infrastructure work, with careful review. What success looks like in 6 months All infrastructure in Terraform and GitOps, deployed through CI with plan-on-PR and approved apply. No hand-made resources, no secrets in Git. UAT and Production environments live, with high availability, private networking and tested DR. The CDC pipeline monitored end to end, with alerts on lag and failures, a dead-letter queue and documented recovery runbooks. Budgets and cost dashboards in place for GCP and BigQuery. Benefits : We like to think that talent grows at Ginesys and stays at Ginesys. To ensure this, we provide our employees with the best working environment, the latest technology and continuous support. We go out of our way to retain the small business feeling with which we started and stimulate innovation and collaboration through teamwork and our non-hierarchical approach. We offer competitive salary, and other fantastic perks and benefits, such as: Ginesys Academy for holistic training and development Comprehensive health insurance coverage Excellent rewards and recognition policy Transparent compensation policy with no unnecessary deduction in CTC Annual company off-site and a variety of events, celebrations throughout the year Travelling opportunities between our offices across the country.
